name: Campus Equipment Booking - Muon thiet bi hoc tap
description: Build a campus equipment lending application for students and teaching staff. Students browse available laptops, projectors and lab kits, request an item for a time interval and track approval, checkout and return. Staff manage inventory, approve or reject requests, record returns and report overdue loans. Prevent overlapping approved bookings for the same equipment, reject invalid time intervals and keep a traceable history of lending actions. Deliver a documented REST API, a usable web interface, automated checks for booking conflicts, and a short demonstration. Work in a four-person PM/BA/DEV/QA team. Demonstrate partial progress, artifact submission, review feedback and a revised submission before accepting the final delivery.

milestones.title: M1 - Analysis
milestones.description: Define equipment, booking and loan rules. Deliver the use cases, data model and UI flow for requesting, approving, checking out and returning equipment.

checklistItems.content: Equipment and booking use cases include valid and invalid time intervals
Data model explains equipment, booking, approval and return history
Wireframes cover student booking and staff approval

milestones.title: M2 - Implementation
milestones.description: Implement equipment availability, booking approval, checkout and returns. Demonstrate conflict protection and tests for overlapping bookings.

checklistItems.content: Student can request equipment and staff can approve or reject a booking
Overlapping approved bookings for the same equipment are rejected
Checkout and return update availability and retain history

milestones.title: M3 - Handover
milestones.description: Deliver setup instructions, a test report and a short demo of booking, conflict handling, approval, checkout and return.

checklistItems.content: A new developer can start the app using the setup guide
Test evidence includes conflicts, invalid dates and the full loan lifecycle
Demo explains completed work and remaining limitations
